The '''Tuldok clan''' was a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from [[Recopia]] who periodically raided the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==History==
Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], they returned in triumph as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] to menace the small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison and preyed on Imperial traffic.<ref name="CatCW" />

During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Tuldoks assumed legitimate control of the planetary government of [[Recopia]].<ref name="CatCW" />
